proposal.reason: No fix needed in git. The frontend pod is Running and Ready, and the frontend, api and redis Services each have a ready endpoint. Argo reports demo-app Synced and Healthy. The earlier crash was a transient startup race. Nginx exited at 19:29:02 with 'host not found in upstream "api"' because the api Service did not resolve yet, and kubelet restarted it. The restart at 19:29:31 succeeded. The api deployment was also reverted by commit 3ab538b ("revert memory limit too low"), which likely caused the api disruption around that time.
proposal.root_cause: Transient startup race: nginx resolved the upstream "api" before the api Service/pods were available, exited with code 1 and restarted. It has recovered, and the api config was restored by 3ab538b.
